description: Source code for ARM architecture timer driver in Zephyr RTOS, implementing timer interrupt handling, tickless kernel support, and system clock initialization.

methods.name: arm_arch_timer_compare_isr
methods.description: Interrupt Service Routine for ARM architecture timer compare event, updates system tick and handles tickless mode.

methods.name: sys_clock_set_timeout
methods.description: Sets the system clock timeout for next tick, supporting tickless kernel mode.

methods.name: sys_clock_elapsed
methods.description: Returns the number of elapsed ticks since last check.

methods.name: sys_clock_cycle_get_32
methods.description: Returns current timer count as 32-bit value.

methods.name: sys_clock_cycle_get_64
methods.description: Returns current timer count as 64-bit value.

methods.name: arch_busy_wait
methods.description: Busy-wait for specified microseconds using the timer.

methods.name: smp_timer_init
methods.description: Initializes timer on secondary cores in SMP configuration.

methods.name: sys_clock_driver_init
methods.description: System clock driver initialization, sets up timer and interrupt.
